title: Submit Response
description: Server response to any POST /v1/submit message (heartbeat, measurement, failure). Contains only a lease decision, a config version number, and a revocation flag. No commands, no URLs, no scripts.

accepted.description: Whether the submitted message was accepted and stored.

config_version.description: Current authoritative config version. If different from the agent's running version, the agent fetches the new config.

revoked.description: If true, this device has been revoked. The agent must stop sending immediately.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code. Present only when accepted is false.

error_message.description: Human-readable description. Present only when accepted is false.
